environment_caveats: Lighthouse ran DESKTOP only (formFactor=desktop, cpuSlowdownMultiplier=1, throughputKbps=10240). Mobile scores typically run 10-20 performance points lower and are NOT represented here.
Client record status is 'onboarding', not 'active' (unchanged since 2026-08-27). Audited anyway because build_status=pushed_main and the apex responds 200. Confirm the status field is correct.

Client record has no apex_cutover.completed_at field; apex origin selected from cut_over_at (2026-08-09) plus a live 200 response with no x-robots-tag noindex. Staging Pages preview still carries noindex, so the apex is the correct target.
4 DataForSEO instant_pages checks (5 on the Raleigh page) were re-verified false-positive against the live HTML and excluded from verdicts. See excluded_false_positives per URL.

lighthouse_issues holds the top 5 per URL; lighthouse_failing_audit_ids holds the full failing list for future diffs. The 2026-08-27 baseline stored top 5 only, so new_issues lists only IDs never seen anywhere in the prior audit (per-URL reshuffles of already-known IDs are not counted as new).
